note: Candidates reviewed for this update but not admitted, with the reason and the evidence that would reopen each.

entries.candidate: Vantage Data Centers 'Project Latigo' PUD (portions of Sections 1, 2, 3 and 11, T12N R67W and Section 35, T13N R67W, Laramie County, Wyoming)
entries.reason: Re-checked on 27 October 2026 through the Laramie County Legistar web API (local legistar-laramie-latigo-vantage-datacenter-matters.json; title search for Latigo, Vantage and data center): the only Latigo item remains Planning Commission file 26-426 (applicant field Vantage Data Centers), with no site-plan, development-agreement or other new file since the us-co-wy-mt-nm-p4 hold. No captured public text yet says the PUD is for a data center, and the only locator remains the five-section PLSS union.
entries.reopen_condition: A captured public record describing Project Latigo as a Vantage data-center campus (staff report, minutes, published proceedings, Vantage release or a utility/DEQ filing) with a parcel-level or site-plan locator; a site-plan approval within 85 days would support permitted.

entries.candidate: Meta Cheyenne data center (existing imported record imported:semiconductor-atlas:meta-cheyenne) - fact sheet of 1 September 2026
entries.reason: Meta's Cheyenne fact sheet (PDF dated 1 September 2026, local meta-asset-cheyenne; asset sitemap lastmod 3 September 2026) refers to operational data center buildings and jobs 'once completed', but it is older than the record's existing under_construction observation of 9 October 2026, so it cannot refresh the status.
entries.reopen_condition: A Meta, City of Cheyenne or Laramie County record dated after 9 October 2026 stating a newer construction stage, completion or operation of the Cheyenne campus.

entries.candidate: Meta Los Lunas 'anticipated Meta project' (possible further development at the Los Lunas campus; Greater Kudu LLC Tract A3A, Huning Ranch Business Park)
entries.reason: The Village of Los Lunas's draft minutes in the 6 August 2026 packet (us-co-wy-mt-nm-p4) mention 'the anticipated Meta project' as a future revenue source, and the county's 2024 orthoimagery shows graded ground, a substation and support buildings on the 466-acre Greater Kudu LLC tract that adjoins the data-hall tract added here. No record names a new Meta project, its buildings or status; it is not added as a project.
entries.reopen_condition: A dated Meta, Village of Los Lunas (IRB ordinance, development agreement, building permit) or Valencia County record naming a new Meta building or phase at Los Lunas; it would be a new project on the site curated:meta-los-lunas-data-center-messenger-loop reusing its campus locator.

entries.candidate: NMRD Data Center LLC (PNM) parcel, 1501 Athene Dr NW, Huning Ranch Business Park Tract A3B, Los Lunas
entries.reason: The Valencia County parcel layer lists Tract A3B (113.9 ac) under the owner name 'NMRD DATA CENTER LLC (PNM)', but the county's 2024 orthoimagery shows a solar array on it; the name refers to a utility-side renewable entity serving the Meta campus, not a data centre.
entries.reopen_condition: None unless a record describes a data-centre building on Tract A3B.

entries.candidate: Site Layer 1 Data Center Project (Grant County, NM) - later permitted status
entries.reason: Admitted here as announced from the 7 October 2026 initial NSR application. The NMED air permit, when issued, would authorize the gas-engine plant, not the data-centre buildings, so it alone would not establish permitted status for the data-centre development (an air permit is ancillary consent).
entries.reopen_condition: A Grant or Hidalgo County land-use or building approval for the data-centre buildings (authority, date, reference, approved work), or evidence of site works, dated after 7 October 2026.

entries.candidate: Meta Prineville Data Center (Vitesse LLC lots on SW Connect Way, Prineville, Oregon): earlier hold re-checked
entries.reason: Not re-proposed. The new Prineville records read in this pass (Planning Commission brief of 20 October 2026; the 13 and 27 October council packets) mention data centres only generically (utility extensions and an airport ASR well 'paid for by the data centers') and, for Meta, only as a peak-demand assumption in the Apple PRZ06 Exhibit A flow table; none states that Meta operates its Prineville campus or ties Meta to the Vitesse LLC lots. The us-west-mountain-p1 hold therefore stands.
entries.reopen_condition: Unchanged from us-west-mountain-p1: a dated in-window Meta, city or county record stating the Prineville campus operates or naming a new building under construction, plus a record tying the campus to its tax lots.

entries.candidate: Amazon / Port of Morrow airport land (68.5 acres) and Morrow County Rural Strategic Investment Program coordination (Boardman, Oregon): September and October 2026 commission packets
entries.reason: The Port of Morrow's September 2026 packet (local pom-packet-202609.pdf, generated 8 September, scanned and read by OCR) reproduces the 3 August minutes already held by us-or-wa-p4 (sale of 68.5 acres at the airport to Amazon; approval of the SIP joint coordination framework with Morrow County). The only description of a data-centre project of about 1,300 acres and USD 10 billion is a member of the public's written comment, which is not a primary statement and is not relied on. The October 2026 packet (local pom-packet-202610.pdf, generated 14 October) contains no data-centre project item; its Amazon material is a general article on Amazon's Eastern Oregon water investments. Morrow County's own hosts did not answer earlier passes.
entries.reopen_condition: A dated Port, Morrow County, Business Oregon or Amazon record naming a data-centre project on the airport land or under the SIP (for example a SIP agreement, enterprise-zone authorization or site plan) with a tax-lot locator.

entries.candidate: Hillsboro, Oregon municipal records (enterprise-zone agreements and land-use decisions for data centres) via alternative hosts

entries.reason: Grant County BOCC agenda covers of 19 and 26 October 2026 and the 197-page 26 October packet (OCR) contain no data-centre item (its development agreement concerns a solar project); the 4 November 2026 Planning Commission workshop agenda covers only the comprehensive-plan periodic update. entries.reopen_condition: New dated records on these hosts naming a data-centre project.
